translation:
With dysenteric diarrhea one must be careful to distinguish yin and yang; water coming to overcome earth is the root cause of the illness. Cold damage and wrongful purgation are mostly like this; free defecation and spontaneous free urination are of the same kind.
Diarrhea of the three yang has the whole body feverish; hands and feet warm belongs to the Great Yin (Taiyin). The Lesser Yin (Shaoyin) makes the body like ice; if the heart is cool (cold) it may rescue the Terminal Yin (Jueyin).
Cold damage again has purulent bloody stools; the intestines and stomach, cold yin, is what the pathogen lodges in. Clear and turbid not separated, carrying channel dampness; not comparable to common loss of blood.
As to the rest, the disorders of the large and small urination, in this very gate one may seek the rules. Cold damage transmission and change is like wind and thunder, not resembling miscellaneous disorders that readily pass through cold.
translator_notes: 三陽下痢=diarrhea of the three yang; 太陰/少陰/厥陰=Taiyin/Shaoyin/Jueyin.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
Shortness of breath is that qi finds it hard to spread and disperse; the pathogen qi already gathers and fills the chest, causing oppression. Qi going against is coarseness and its rising upward; in the affairs of the world nothing is certain.
Huo luan (sudden turmoil), vomiting and dry retching, hiccup and reversal, cough and rapid breathing — this chapter repeats them, drawing the three-cornered inference by analogy, with the living method treat them and not one is lost.
translator_notes: 反三隅=deduce by analogy (from the Analects' 舉一反三).
unresolved: "噦晼/噦逆" obscure term for hiccup; rendered as hiccup.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
The jaundice illness of cold damage can alarm the heart; the spleen and stomach, damp and heat, steam each other. Damp qi dominates in plenty, drawing the skin like a peel; heat qi invades and steeps, the image of a ruined lotus.
Difficult urination is jaundice; easy free urination is named accumulated blood. Whole body becomes yellow with the four lips turning black; the deeper the heat the deeper the cold, the deeper yellow also.
At the worst it harms the blood and issues macules of jaundice; taking advantage of deficiency it surges out to the ends of the skin. Slight like measles or mosquito-bite traces; severe, then like areca coin.
Mosquito-bite traces appear only on hands and feet issuing macules; the abdominal skin is not bearable to view. The patient raves and sees large dots, fresh red then turning purple, this is concluded as macules.
The patient is calm and sees small dots, first red then turning yellow — the trace of macules is observed. Always it is that the pathogen qi does not dissipate; first sweating and purging produce the mutual combat.
Most to be feared are blood macules like fruit; the dragon fire of life gate burns the kidney channel. When macules issue, quickly cast the appropriate class; Shengma Tang (Cimicifuga Decoction) moreover is broad/relaxing here.
translator_notes: 發斑=issuing macules; 蓄血=accumulation of blood.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）
